detail.title: Synthesis of Systemic Assumption Testing, Preference Formation, and Responsibility Frameworks
detail.summary: This proposal interprets experimental results regarding memory-augmented reinforcement learning, updates project trajectories for axiom testing and responsibility frameworks, and consolidates these inquiries into ongoing research.

detail.title: Foundation Assumption Testing and Self-Correction
detail.question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning or operation, demonstrate that the assumption is inadequate, and better characterize it?
detail.reason: Maintaining active progress on identifying and testing internal assumptions.

children.title: Path-Dependent Preference Formation in Reinforcement Learning

detail.title: Path-Dependent Preference Formation in Reinforcement Learning
detail.question: How do reinforcement learning agents or memory-augmented neural networks demonstrate path-dependent preference formation based on historical experience versus programmed objectives?
detail.reason: Proceeding with verification of path-dependency observations after initial inconclusive results.

children.title: Foundations of Artificial Agency and Responsibility

detail.title: Foundations of Artificial Agency and Responsibility
detail.question: What conceptual frameworks allow an artificial intelligence to attribute responsibility for its actions, and how does this relate to agent autonomy?
detail.reason: Maintaining progress on synthesizing agency frameworks.
